collection.title: DS DS3 Hatchback 2019 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a DS3 Hatchback 2019 - 2022 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have rear blade available, please click on the Rear Blades tab below.
